verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a sandbox that is completely separate from production, with instant self-serve signup and per-product simulations that use no real money. It covers all products except the Connected Account APIs. AI-native access is built in: the Developer MCP on a sandbox-only endpoint lets agents create test resources and simulate events, the CLI defaults to sandbox with an explicit `--prod` opt-in, and a sandbox quickstart is published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-to-sandbox workflow, and sandbox parity for the Connected Account APIs.
